scope: CPU local post-Q2 projection diagnostic; no full-model intervention or CUDA speed claim
sampling: new uniform without replacement over actual observed native grid; explicit inclusion probabilities and design weights
score_precision: FP32 operands/products/GEMMs; FP64 final energy reductions
static_support: design-weighted mean training score on task0 opposite seed, same step/expert/block
gain_donor: task0 opposite seed for both task0 and task6 tests; same step/expert/block
gain_anchor: bias-free FP32 dense linear signal times FP32 gate
gain_fit: nonnegative scalar per donor and policy, FP64 weighted least squares; R pools all four frozen masks
gain_denominator_floor: D * 1e-24; NA is retained and cannot pass a gate
native_candidate_order: V2.float * mask.float * gain.float -> BF16 -> F.linear with effective BF16 W2 and original BF16 bias once -> BF16 gate multiplication
fp32_control: same mask and FP32 gain, FP32 linear/bias/gate, no intermediate BF16 cast
risk_normalization: sum(design_weight * norm2(CPU native BF16 dense projection without bias, times BF16 gate))
native_cpu_gpu_drift: report dense CPU projection including bias against captured GPU target separately
E_vs_A_role: auxiliary per-scope comparison; not an additional family gate
per_task_gate: at least 3/4 scopes, covering each seed and step, assessed independently for task0 Fit and task6 Validation
observer_noop_requirement: each of the four inputs must pass all four scheduler latents bitwise against its own separate-process plain run
checkpoint_granularity: score scope/row chunk; policy-specific donor gain; test policy/gain/row chunk
final_acceptance: local gate outcomes do not imply CUDA speed, 160-position sparsity, or formal20 video quality
